notes: The three articles on רֶכֶב, מַחֲנֶה and מֶרְכָּבָה take the possessive *his* the ASV writes in the phrase's determiner slot; no suffix stands in any of those phrases to claim it (rule 41).
*away* is added under rule 44's subtraction test, since נוּס is the fleeing and *fled* has already written it; מֵעַל fuses to *from*, headed on the governing first morpheme (rule 23).
